text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2019. While the Hansen dataset flagged 1.8 ha (0.05% of the property) as tree-cover loss, the independent JRC 2020 reference map—used to validate changes—found no forest cover in that area at all. Since the JRC map is more accurate for this type of assessment, it contradicts the Hansen signal. The 1.8 ha in question was part of a planted forest (Pinus spp.), but the loss signal appears to be either a false detection or a non-forest change below the 0.5 ha minimum event threshold. No deforestation or land-use change is confirmed for 2019.
